about: What Doctor does when someone taps 'Find out why' on a failure line (Aryn, 2026-10-23, 4:30-4:31 am: 'yes'). The flow is proved in projects/foundations/FingusFoundations/FingusFoundations/Systems/FailureDiagnosis.lean: checks first, then at most one question, asked only when no check settles it, always with Not sure; the step shown depends only on the check results and the answer. 'runs' says who runs a check: 'device' the app on the person's phone or PC screen (it works when the PC does not answer), 'pc' Doctor on the PC. 'kind' is the audit's reading of the failure by its code path (projects/aero/audit__wording_2026-10-23.md): retry (the same action can succeed again), cause (something outside the action can be fixed), nothing (nothing the person can do).
